query: Considered the strongest recorded tropical cyclone, which cyclone had a film made about it in 2007?

The strongest recorded tropical cyclone was Hurricane Maria, also known as the "Great Hurricane of 1739." It occurred on September 7, 1739, near the Bahamas and caused significant damage to coastal communities. The storm's landfall in the Bahamas resulted in a massive amount of destruction, including the destruction of many homes and businesses.

However, it is worth noting that Hurricane Maria was not as strong as some other known tropical cyclones during its time on the Atlantic Ocean. It had a record-breaking wind speed of 74 mph (120 km/h) at its peak intensity, which made it one of the strongest recorded storms in history.
